title: Project Aether
description: A visually enhanced, performance-optimized Fabric modpack that refines vanilla Minecraft with smoother gameplay, improved lighting, and subtle aesthetic upgrades - all while keeping the authentic feel of the game.
body:
Project Aether is my attempt to make Minecraft what it should always have been: smooth, beautiful, and cozy.
No clutter or unnecessary mods-just what makes the game cleaner, brighter, and more enjoyable.

Everything that can be improved has been improved without breaking the vanilla atmosphere: the graphics are smoother, the animations are more lively, and the interface is clearer. At the same time, everything works quickly-no lag, no freezes, and no endless restarts.

This build is for those who just want to play calmly, enjoy the views, build, travel, and feel that very “Minecraft magic,” but in a more modern and polished form.

Project Aether is vanilla brought to perfection.
